---
name: Formalisation task
about: Formalise a bounded mathematical result
---

## Mathematical intent and sources
State the informal result, definitions, hypotheses, and relevant source locations.

## Acceptance criteria
Describe semantic fidelity, expected deliverables, and verification and proof-integrity checks.

## Dependencies and prior reports
Link relevant issues, libraries, and attempts. Describe what has changed since any prior failure.

## Permitted scope
Specify files, dependencies, changes allowed, and decisions requiring explicit human approval.

## Budget and stopping conditions
Set a bounded budget or stopping rule. State what partial result would be useful and when to escalate.
